evidence: Authoritative frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx was read with openpyxl: Quality Checks sheet row 20 (check 19) requires solve.sh installation to expected paths and reference operation under the stated runtime; Deterministic Checks row 34 requires valid LF bash, /app output, no protected-directory writes, pkill or NODE_ENV=production. Internal Quality Checks row 20 has the older no-network wording, which the shipped Quality Checks row and frozen skill's public-network profile override. The frozen skill references/quality-checks.md section 19 additionally names DB_PATH and idempotent seeding. All task citations below are relative to .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task/. solution/solve.sh:1-2 has '#!/bin/bash' and 'set -euo pipefail'; lines 4-7 create /app and resolve/check the sibling app source without a machine-specific path; lines 14-25 limit cleanup to /app/app.db and its WAL/SHM files, refusing installation when an existing database file is open; line 26 copies the complete shipped app to /app. No statement writes /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution, kills an app, sets production mode, or downloads/installs dependencies. Read-only Git Bash 'bash -n' returned 0; a byte check found no CRLF. This statically confirms the installer contract; the reviewed runtime driver does not execute solve.sh. environment/instructions/integration.md:3-11 states the Node 22/NODE_PATH runtime, node /app/server.js, 0.0.0.0:3000, public/index.html, /api/health, DB_PATH override, restart durability and delivery without /assets or /instructions. solution/app/server.js:2-5 imports only Node built-ins, Express and better-sqlite3; environment/Dockerfile:3,9-12 and tests/Dockerfile:9,20-21 supply the exact two runtime packages (5.1.0 and 12.4.1). The package.json runtime dependency declarations match. server.js:8 uses 'process.env.DB_PATH || process.env.SQLITE_PATH || path.join(root, 'app.db')'; lines 113-127 listen on 0.0.0.0 with default port 3000, create the requested DB parent and initialize with 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS', adding revision only when absent. Startup performs no INSERT; examples are separate shipped files, so restarting cannot reseed or duplicate saved records. The optional SQLITE_PATH fallback does not override DB_PATH. server.js:12 provides health, lines 100-102 serve shipped starters and public/index.html from __dirname. public/index.html references the two present public/assets files, not the external filesystem /assets mount. src/app.tsx:1-3 imports local bundled modules and line 56 loads the shipped /starters route; runtime.ts imports its local parser bundle. No delivered app file is a symlink/reparse point. Read-only 'node --check solution/app/server.js' returned 0. Independently recomputed SHA256 values match all 22 actual_app_files in qc/runs/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/golden/run-golden-20260930-070504/RESULTS.json. That executed driver's launch_workflow.py:27-38 copies the whole app to a temporary app directory, gives it UID/GID 65534, then invokes node on server.js from cwd /tmp with sanitized PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT and DB_PATH. Lines 51-57 require an HTTP 200 health response. Raw RESULTS.json facts.S01.startup_ready.evidence shows automatic hello.js execution, twelve rendered squared values and console output; pre/post node_returncode values are 0 and both browser error arrays are empty. actual-restart.json records one successful canonical restart, PID 16 to 335. Raw facts.S22.process_restart_durability.evidence contains exactly the same four saved records before and after restart, including primary id 3/revision 2; facts.S22.process_restart_write.evidence shows revision 3 afterward with unrelated records exact and no fallback. library_flow.cjs:37-47 independently compares complete saved lists and loads the records around that restart. These observations support actual portable startup and idempotent persistence. Limits: the driver copies the app directly instead of running solve.sh, and its DB_PATH equals the relocated app's default filename, so a distinct DB_PATH override was verified from source rather than isolated empirically. Full configured judge execution, Oracle and target-model scores are not established by these scripted observations and are not claimed here.
counterexample: Conforming-alternative challenge: an app using a writable DB_PATH outside its source directory, loading examples from its own /starters route, or fetching allowed public browser assets remains compatible with the stated contract; the current golden gives DB_PATH precedence and requires neither /assets nor /instructions at runtime. Broken-app challenge: a server ignoring DB_PATH and always using __dirname/app.db could still pass this particular relocated golden driver because the driver's supplied DB_PATH is that same filename. The current golden is not that broken implementation: server.js:8 and :114-115 directly use the supplied value. A server that reseeds/duplicates records on restart would be caught by the recorded exact four-record before/after comparison, and current startup contains no insertion. These are scope checks, not unexecuted mutation tests claimed as measured results.
